image_description: A black and white close-up photograph of a bicycle wheel hub featuring a ventilated disc brake rotor. The rotor is mounted to the center of the wheel with visible bolts. A hydraulic caliper is mounted on the left side, clamping onto the rotor. Bicycle spokes radiate outward from the hub. In the background, parts of the bike frame (fork) and a shoe are visible.
